title: Natural-video EEG response encoding
scientific_question: Can permitted training responses and fixed video features predict the complete EEG response to held video identities in the same six participants, beyond matched or absent neural-training controls?
primary_outputs: Held video EEG response arrays, independently joined to each participant, channel and time coordinate; the answer is measured EEG rather than the source paper narrative.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: All17 fixed visual feature outputs and permitted EEG responses for video IDs1..1000, with person/channel/time order and fit-only transforms.
At query time the current video features and sealed training state; measured, mismatched and absent training-neural views remain separate conditions.
forbidden_inputs: EEG responses for query videos 1001..1102, query-derived normalization/noise-ceiling selection, prior query transcripts and protected reference results.
Answer-bearing targets or native whole-session transforms imported into the prospective condition.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Source protocol uses video IDs1..1000 for training and 1001..1102 for query, six person positions and complete 127-by 1800 output coordinates; runtime bundle aliases do not replace the canonical join.
allowed_inputs.split: Same-six-person new-video split. Group every repetition of a video; preserve literal native whole-session normalization solely as a separately labeled retrospective reproduction branch.
allowed_inputs.coverage: One registration; source scope contains 36 paired-seed bundles,3672 query contexts and 22032 person-video predictions. These are planned full-support condition counts, not completed runs or independent datasets. Authentic input and deployment qualification remain absent.

biological_unit: Participant, with repeated videos shared across people and trials nested within sessions.
case_definition: One video query predicts the response of all six known people, [6,127,1800].

split.policy: Same-six-person new-video split. Group every repetition of a video; preserve literal native whole-session normalization solely as a separately labeled retrospective reproduction branch.

reference.role: Pinned preprocessing and encoding analysis source. Session-wide EEG normalization uses test responses, and a raw-preprocessing source defect requires review; published derivatives are not invalidated. No qualified reference run exists.

controls: Keep all repeats of each video together; disclose shared stimuli with BOLD Moments and unknown checkpoint exposure.
Freeze fit-only target scaling and masks; do not select channels/times by test-derived reliability.
Report audiovisual/ocular/task covariates and whole-clip future information; encoding accuracy cannot remove them.

direct_observation.representation: The query observation is a video feature tensor and the requested answer is held EEG; showing the target EEG would reverse the task.
direct_observation.boundary: A direct neural-waveform interpretation assay would require a separately specified endpoint and must not inherit encoding scores.

typed_viewer.representation: A viewer of held EEG would expose the prediction target; viewing stimulus material does not become neural-signal interpretation.
typed_viewer.boundary: Any future stimulus viewer must preserve the encoding target and be assessed separately.
missing: No typed neural-viewer endpoint is delivered.

tool_assisted.representation: Controller.investigate supplies an actual provider action loop with run_python, optional fit_helper and finish actions over the permitted current context; source is unconfigured and not executed here.
tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh query state, same permitted information within each paired tool condition, no query labels or grading feedback; provider/runtime qualification remains external.
missing: Unconfigured native/provider transport and authentic full-input execution.

frozen_program.representation: Controller.preseal freezes run(request) source before numeric exposure and run_candidates executes it for training, each current video and report; provider transport rejects F calls after exposure.
frozen_program.boundary: Commit global policy before numeric exposure; no source revision or provider call during frozen execution; native reproduction is separate.

primary.name: Participant-macro mean coordinate-wise Pearson correlation over held videos
primary.aggregation: Correlate predicted and measured responses across 102 videos separately at every 127x1800 coordinate, average all coordinates within each person, then average six people. Undefined coordinates propagate according to the scorer, not selective deletion.
primary.rationale: Assesses held neural-response structure over the full frozen target basis; calibration error is reported separately because correlation alone ignores scale and bias.

secondary: Prespecified posterior-channel/time masks as secondary views only.
Paired measured-versus-mismatch/absent neural-information contrasts, investigative-minus-frozen and helper effects; retain all signed outcomes.
Native reproduction status and evidence-backed protocol-report credit remain separate non-neural-accuracy endpoints.

comparators.name: Training-selected R1/R2/R3 champion
comparators.inputs: The same permitted training EEG, all required feature coordinates and fixed training folds.
comparators.procedure: Existing source selects each participant’s reference family/settings using the complete training-only inner grid, then grades its held predictions; no query-based champion selection.

comparators.name: Training mean and zero predictions
comparators.inputs: Permitted training response means or no neural information.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed simple baselines expose scale/correlation pathologies and no-signal performance.

comparators.name: Mismatched and absent neural-training views
comparators.inputs: Declared mismatch or absent labels under the same permitted stimulus feature support.
comparators.procedure: Existing matched condition axis tests dependence on aligned neural training; it does not isolate causal neural mechanisms.

nuisance_controls: Keep all repeats of each video together; disclose shared stimuli with BOLD Moments and unknown checkpoint exposure.

evaluation.uncertainty: Six-person and shared-video resampling in the source is conditional on fixed fits and the observed cohort/videos; no refitting uncertainty, population confidence or confirmatory winner follows.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every held video and 127x1800 coordinate for all six people and prescribed condition panels. Preserve incomplete, failed, constant or undefined outcomes; no best-success subset and no rewarding unsupported report claims.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

Six-person naturalistic collection; shared video families with BOLD Moments require overlap-aware evaluation.
Retrieve bounded versioned manifests/schema and verify actual recording inputs, labels, alignment and biological identity; catalog identity alone is insufficient.
Pin exact official code revision/entrypoint and license, inspect loader-to-data compatibility, and select a meaningful signal-derived reference.
Audit data, stimulus, code and checkpoint access/redistribution terms before packet distribution.
Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.
Implement and run data adapter/evaluator/reference, matched controls and malformed-output tests; independently reproduce results before any validation claim.
